description: Every run Meta recorded — for one rule (ruleId) or the whole ad account — with what each changed and the rule as it was at that run. Filter by objectId, action (CHANGED_BUDGET, PAUSED, UNPAUSED, CHANGED_BID …) or hideNoChanges. Read-only. Free.

action.description: CHANGED_BUDGET, CHANGED_BID, PAUSED, UNPAUSED, NOT_CHANGED, ERROR, EMAIL …

adAccountId.description: Meta ad account id (act_… or the bare number) from list_meta_ads; required — every rule lives on one ad account

objectId.description: only runs that touched this object
